characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT FACIAL FEATURES DECAL for a sculpted three-dimensional adult East Asian character in Zhouzhu, refined Japanese anime 3D with delicate chosen hand-painted lines. This is a UV texture, NOT a portrait or a head. Square canvas. Draw ONLY two eyebrows, two detailed brown eyes with eyelids, a tiny restrained nose/nostril mark, and one natural closed mouth, all frontal and symmetric in neutral calm expression. Feature layout: eye centers at (28%,42%) and (72%,42%); eyebrows around y=32%; nose mark at (50%,60%); mouth centered at (50%,73%). Entire features within 12% to 88% canvas width and 26% to 78% height. The area between features and ALL background must be genuinely transparent alpha: no skin fill, face contour, ears, head, neck, hair, body, clothing, accessories, scene, grid, labels, text or borders. Soft precise anti-aliased edges. Adult facial proportions, fine anime eyelids and irises, subtle natural lip color. No giant childlike eyes, no chibi, no magical colors, no heavy makeup, no lighting or cast shadows. Subject: adult man aged about 25-30; slender confident brows, focused almond-shaped eyes, understated mouth, clean-shaven.
